Trishakti Power Generation Corporation
Letter of Recommendation
LETTER OF RECOMMENDATION
Our ref: 22
31 Mar 2026
This office has engaged M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for the work “Residential
Quarters — Uttar Pradesh Pkg-25” (Rs. 4171.00 Lakh), completed on 05 Jun 2021. On the basis
of that engagement we record the following:
Adherence to the sanctioned programme of work and milestone dates;
Quality of workmanship accepted at inspection without material objection;
Compliance with safety and statutory obligations on site;
Responsiveness of the contractor's site management.
National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. completed the engagement within the sanctioned time and
cost, and their conduct on site was professional throughout. We would consider them for
similar works.
Verification: Vikram Desai, ee@dept.gov.in, +91-9830000000.
